# Lex Minds (`https://lexminds.in`)
> Legal Education, Research, Writing & Practical Learning

## Overview
Lex Minds is an independent, student-led legal education platform dedicated to empowering law students and researchers through legal learning, research fellowships, structured manuscript peer-review, and practical skill development.

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Legal Internship & Fellowship Programmes (`/internships`)
- **Student-Focused Programmes**: Structured experiential learning cohorts in legal research, statutory interpretation, case digest drafting, and citation standardization.
- **Practice Areas**:
  - Corporate Law & Regulatory Compliance
  - Constitutional & Appellate Law
  - Intellectual Property Rights
  - Technology & Data Privacy (DPDP Act 2023)
  - Commercial Dispute Resolution & Arbitration
  - Criminal Jurisprudence (BNS / BNSS / BSA)
- **Application Workflow**: Multi-step application with Statement of Purpose (SOP), academic credentials, Google authentication, and nominal administrative evaluation fee (₹39 INR) processed via Razorpay. Note: Payment does not guarantee selection.

### 2. Article Publishing & Legal Journal (`/articles` & `/publish`)
- **Student-Led Editorial Review**: Publishing analytical research papers, case commentaries, and statutory analyses.
- **Publish With Us**: Transparent manuscript intake and editorial review process with citation verification and archival publication dockets. Nominal editorial evaluation fee (₹99 INR) processed via Razorpay. Payment does not guarantee acceptance or publication.
- **Citation Standards**: Formatted to Bluebook and OSCOLA standards.

### 3. Mentorship & Clinical Guidance (`/mentors` & `/about`)
- Advisory panel of experienced legal practitioners, advocates, and academic scholars.
- Practical guidance in legal writing, research methodologies, and career development.
